statement: ∀ (a b c d : ℝ), a ≤ b → c < d → IsEmpty (↑(Icc a b) ≃ₜ ↑(Ioo c d))
script:
# name: set-icc-ioo-test
# technique: test fallback (test_fallback recipe): instances the kernel checks, chosen by hand
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.Sets.Homeomorphism.Icc_not_homeomorph_Ioo
# description: the claim at the instances below, each proved independently of the claim
SEED = 0
CASES = [
    (['0', '1', '0', '1', '(by norm_num)', '(by norm_num)'], False, 'have key : ∀ (a b c d : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c < d), IsEmpty (Icc a b ≃ₜ Ioo c d) := by
  intro a b c d hab hcd
  refine ⟨fun e => ?_⟩
  haveI : CompactSpace (Icc a b) := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.1 isCompact_Icc
  haveI : CompactSpace (Ioo c d) := e.compactSpace
  have hc : IsCompact (Ioo c d) := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.2 inferInstance
  have hcl := hc.isClosed.closure_eq
  rw [closure_Ioo hcd.ne] at hcl
  have : c ∈ Ioo c d := hcl ▸ left_mem_Icc.2 hcd.le
  exact lt_irrefl c this.1
exact @key (0) (1) (0) (1) ((by norm_num)) ((by norm_num))'),
    (['0', '0', '0', '1', '(by norm_num)', '(by norm_num)'], True, 'have key : ∀ (a b c d : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c < d), IsEmpty (Icc a b ≃ₜ Ioo c d) := by
  intro a b c d hab hcd
  refine ⟨fun e => ?_⟩
  haveI : CompactSpace (Icc a b) := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.1 isCompact_Icc
  haveI : CompactSpace (Ioo c d) := e.compactSpace
  have hc : IsCompact (Ioo c d) := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.2 inferInstance
  have hcl := hc.isClosed.closure_eq
  rw [closure_Ioo hcd.ne] at hcl
  have : c ∈ Ioo c d := hcl ▸ left_mem_Icc.2 hcd.le
  exact lt_irrefl c this.1
exact @key (0) (0) (0) (1) ((by norm_num)) ((by norm_num))'),
    (['-1', '2', '3', '5', '(by norm_num)', '(by norm_num)'], False, 'have key : ∀ (a b c d : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c < d), IsEmpty (Icc a b ≃ₜ Ioo c d) := by
  intro a b c d hab hcd
  refine ⟨fun e => ?_⟩
  haveI : CompactSpace (Icc a b) := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.1 isCompact_Icc
  haveI : CompactSpace (Ioo c d) := e.compactSpace
  have hc : IsCompact (Ioo c d) := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.2 inferInstance
  have hcl := hc.isClosed.closure_eq
  rw [closure_Ioo hcd.ne] at hcl
  have : c ∈ Ioo c d := hcl ▸ left_mem_Icc.2 hcd.le
  exact lt_irrefl c this.1
exact @key (-1) (2) (3) (5) ((by norm_num)) ((by norm_num))'),
]
instances = [kernel_instance(*values, proof=proof, edge=edge) for values, edge, proof in CASES]
